evidence_items.explanation: The response table reports that 21% of surveyed business decision makers ranked lack of confidence in accuracy and reliability among their top three implementation barriers. The June survey covered 200 senior US decision makers at large companies; the report specifies August 2023, so available_at conservatively uses that month's last day.
